title: TokenStore: tokens, aliases, sessions, in-flight refresh, git sentinel
scenario: 1) New TokenStore: getToken('e1') undefined; setToken('e1','a1'), then 'a2' overwrites; clearToken. 2) useTokenFrom('b','a'), chain c->b->a, cycle x->y->x, 11+ hop chain, setToken on aliased env. 3) setSession('e1',{accessToken,refreshToken,expiresAt}) plus alias e2->e1 and in-flight promise; clearSession('e1'), then clearAll(). 4) setRefreshInFlight('e1',p); get e1, get e2, clear. 5) setToken('repo', GIT_SOURCE_TOKEN) and read back; constant equals '__reltio-git-source__'.
expected: 1) Undefined before set; 'a1' then 'a2'; hasToken false after clear. 2) Chains resolve up to 10 hops; cycles and over-deep chains return undefined without hanging; direct setToken drops the alias. 3) Access and refresh tokens returned; clearSession removes them and the alias for that env only; clearAll empties tokens, aliases, sessions and in-flight refreshes. 4) Same promise instance for e1 (concurrent 401s share one refresh); undefined for e2 and after clear. 5) Sentinel round-trips unchanged with its literal value.

title: SessionStore and OAuthCredentialsStore persistence in SecretStorage
scenario: 1) Fake SecretStorage and Memento: saveRefreshToken('e1','r1') twice and ('e2','r2'); inspect secret keys, loadRefreshToken, listEnvironments. 2) deleteRefreshToken('e1'), then delete a never-saved env. 3) saveClientCredentials('e1',{id,secret}); load/has; store only a clientId for 'e2' directly; saveSsoTenantId('e1','t'); deleteClientCredentials('e1').
expected: 1) Secrets hold 'reltio.refreshToken.e1' and '.e2'; listEnvironments is ['e1','e2'] with no duplicate; only the env name list (no token) is in the Memento. 2) e1 secret gone and load is undefined; list is ['e2']; deleting an unknown env does not throw. 3) Keys are reltio.oauth.<env>.clientId/clientSecret/ssoTenantId; e2 with missing secret loads undefined and has=false; delete removes all three keys for e1.

title: OAuth helpers: authorization URL, ssoCheck mapping, refreshTokens contract
scenario: 1) buildAuthorizationUrl({clientId:'id a',clientSecret:'s'},'sso tenant','st&1') parsed with URL. 2) Stub fetch for ssoCheck: {status:'sso'}, {status:'native'}, HTTP 500, rejected fetch, {status:'weird',error:'x'}. 3) Stub fetch for refreshTokens('old',creds): {access_token:'new',expires_in:60} without refresh_token; then a new refresh_token and no expires_in; inspect request headers/body.
expected: 1) Host auth.reltio.com path /oauth/sso; tenant_id, response_type=code, client_id, redirect_uri=http://localhost:8081, state present and percent-encoded; client secret never in URL. 2) 'sso' and 'native' for the first two; the other three throw OAuthLoginError SSO_CHECK_FAILED; POST body has tenant_id, client_id, response_type=code, state, redirect_uri and no client_secret. 3) accessToken 'new', refreshToken 'old', expiresAt about now+60s; second case uses returned refresh token and defaults to 3600s; Basic auth and grant_type=refresh_token.

title: Browser login flow: happy path and typed failures
scenario: 1) Stub ssoCheck -> sso, capture openExternal URL, GET http://localhost:8081/?code=C&state=<state>; stub token endpoint. 2) Stub refreshTokens fetch with HTTP 400/401 for 'old-refresh' and secret 'S3CRET'. 3) Stub ssoCheck -> {status:'native'}; call runBrowserLogin, check port 8081 free and openExternal not called. 4) Occupy port 8081 with a net server; then free it, deliver a valid callback and stub token endpoint HTTP 401.
expected: 1) 200 success page; runBrowserLogin resolves an OAuthSession with future expiresAt; token POST uses grant_type=authorization_code with code and redirect_uri. 2) OAuthLoginError REFRESH_FAILED 'Token refresh failed: HTTP <status>' without refresh token, secret or Basic header. 3) NO_IDP_CONFIGURED naming the tenant; no listener, browser not opened. 4) PORT_BUSY mentioning 8081; EXCHANGE_FAILED 'Token exchange failed: HTTP 401'; no message includes client secret or code.

title: Setup wizard and terms gate: prompts, failed login cleanup, navigation
scenario: 1) Terms gate: first accept persists version; decline/dismiss/unreadable/blank persist nothing; reset re-prompts; add stored older version '0'. 2) Credentials pre-saved; stub runBrowserLogin to throw NO_IDP_CONFIGURED, SSO_CHECK_FAILED, then a generic Error; watch showErrorMessage and stores. 3) Stubbed pickers: cancel at step 2; 'Go back and modify inputs' at step 5; Skip at step 4; token path with SSO tenant id and autoAddSsoTenant returning a tenant.
expected: 1) Accept returns true and stores TERMS_VERSION; decline/dismiss/unreadable/blank return false with no state; accepted returns true with no modal; mismatched version prompts. 2) Each failure deletes the env's client credentials and SSO tenant id, shows a code-specific message (modal for first two, plain 'Login failed:' otherwise) and goes back a step. 3) Cancel creates no environment; back re-runs step 4 (min 1); skip finishes with env only and a hint; auto-added tenant skips the step 4 picker and is not recreated. Reviewer to confirm that wiping credentials on transient errors (e.g. PORT_BUSY) is intended.

scenario: 1) Start runBrowserLogin with stubs, request /?code=C&state=WRONG on port 8081. 2) Request /?state=x with no code; drive the state-mismatch page and check markup characters in any message are rendered as entities.

scenario: 1) Context with no accepted version and showWarningMessage returning 'Decline'; launchSetupWizard with spy deps; createQuickPick/showInputBox never called. 2) Drive stepConfirmAndFinish with {host, accessToken:'A', refreshToken:'R'}; inspect TokenStore, SessionStore secrets, Memento and config writes; paste-token path. 3) Call openSetupGuidePanel twice, capture createWebviewPanel options; make fs.readFile throw or return invalid JSON.

scenario: 1) isSafePathSegment on '', ' a', '.', '..', 'a..b', 'a/b', 'a\\b', 'a\0b', '361.reltio.com'; resolveTokenFileUri(root, ...) with '../x.json', 'a/../../x', 'C:\\x.json', '/etc/x', '' and 'secrets/t.json'. 2) Stub defaultEnvironments entry {host,tenantId,token:'abc',clientSecret:'x'} plus a valid tokenFile-less one; run applyDefaultEnvironments with spies.

title: Login times out if the browser callback never arrives (manual)
scenario: 1) Manual QA (Tier C): start Sign in with browser from the tree, do not complete login, wait over 2 minutes, then retry login immediately. Automated variant would need fake timers around setTimeout.
expected: 1) After 120s 'Login timed out. Please try again.' appears, the localhost:8081 listener is released, and a second attempt does not hit PORT_BUSY.
